newsitem.title: USA: Glasgal sees revs from Cisco agreements.
newsitem.headline: Glasgal sees revs from Cisco agreements.

text.p: Glasgal Communications Inc said Friday it expects to generate orders of several million dollars in its current fiscal year from two new agreements with Cisco Systems Inc.

Under the agreements, Cisco will use Glasgal's subsidiary, Datatec Systems Inc, as a subcontractor for network integration services and will license systems integration software from another Glasgal subsidiary, CASI, as part of Cisco's new Advanced Installation Services program.

"Providing staging and implementation for Cisco's Advanced Installation Services will be a major new growth engine for Glasgal's revenues," said Isaac Gaon, chief executive officer of Glasgal. "We expect this to be the first of many exciting partnerships we will announce this year."
Datatec configures, integrates, deploys, installs and services local and wide-area networks incorporating a broad range of computer hardware, networking systems and software products.
CASI develops and licenses system engineering software that reduces project labor costs and configuration failures.
